name: Vega
tagline: Europe's small launcher: 22 flights from French Guiana, 2012 to 2024
description: Vega is a four-stage launcher (P80, Zefiro 23, Zefiro 9 and AVUM) built by Avio and flown from Europe's Spaceport in French Guiana. It is 30 m tall and 3 m wide, weighs 137 t at liftoff, and lifts about 1,500 kg to a 700 km circular orbit at 90 degrees. It flew 22 times between 2012-02-13 and 2024-09-05, ending with Sentinel-2C: 20 successes and 2 failures. VV15 on 2019-07-11 lost FalconEye-1 when the forward dome of the Zefiro 23 failed; VV17 on 2020-11-17 lost SEOSAT-Ingenio and TARANIS. Vega C is its successor.
best_known_for: Europe's small launcher: 22 flights from French Guiana between 2012 and 2024, 20 of them successful
